honing_confound: Healing values and shield amounts scale with Specialization stat which scales with gear honing. Party buffer effectiveness is gear-indexed. As with Paladin Blessed Aura, tier standing reflects group-content meta where healing/damage-reduction demand is mandatory — solo tier is not applicable.

delivery.evidence: Serenade of Salvation = a ground AoE healing zone placed at target location. Serenade of Courage = buff aura activated from caster position. Buff/shield skills radiate from caster or target position.

footprint.evidence: Serenade of Salvation places a large ground HoT zone that allies must stand in. Party shield skills cover a zone radius around the caster or target. Wide zone coverage for healing/buffing.

geo_text: Bard is the premier ranged support class. Desperate Salvation centers on Serenade of Salvation: a ground zone HoT that heals party members within it over time. Duration and potency scale with the number of Serenade Meter bars consumed (1-3 bars). Support skills (shields, damage buffs, debuffs) are cast throughout the rotation to maximize party benefit. Caster stays at safe range and delivers support output.

control.evidence: Bard has some CC skills (Stigma applies silence/dissonance effects to enemies). CC is a minor rider in the support-focused rotation.

defense.evidence: For ALLIES: Serenade of Salvation = HoT (healing over time). Shield skills. Desperate Salvation specifically amplifies the Serenade of Salvation component. Self-defense for Bard is minimal (glass mage body).

economy.resource_verbatim: Serenade Meter (3 bars maximum — 3 distinct charge levels)
economy.builder_source: Offensive skills and support casts fill Serenade Meter. High meter-fill efficiency rewards active rotation even in support role.
economy.plain_text: THREE-BAR SERENADE METER: Fills via skill usage. Can hold 1, 2, or 3 bars simultaneously. Identity skills: (A) Serenade of Salvation (healing ground AoE) — costs 1/2/3 bars for increasing potency and duration. (B) Serenade of Courage (party damage buff) — same cost scaling. DESPERATE SALVATION IDENTITY: significantly amplifies Serenade of Salvation duration and effectiveness. Meta Bard rotation: fill bars → prioritize Serenade of Salvation for maximum HoT uptime. Serenade of Courage is secondary.

element.evidence: Bard's damage is sound/music-themed. Specific damage type in LA system (Physical vs Magic) is Magical. Thematic element is Sound.

movement.evidence: Bard has moderate mobility — mage body but not as fragile as Sorceress due to support role requiring staying near party. Short-range teleport skills for repositioning.

attr.evidence: Must stay in range of party to deliver healing/buffs (typically within 12-15m of allies). Not melee, not fully long-range.

range.evidence: Serenade of Salvation is a placed AoE that allies must stand in — effective range is party proximity. Offensive skills have moderate range.

tempo.evidence: Desperate Salvation is the sustained support identity: Serenade of Salvation provides continuous HoT while active. The rotation maintains bars and replenishes Serenade of Salvation as it expires. No burst window for the support function.

amp.value: Party healing over time (Serenade of Salvation); Desperate Salvation amplifies duration; secondary: Serenade of Courage +5/10/15% party damage for 8/12/16s
amp.evidence: Directly sourced from search results: '1, 2, or 3 bars. Serenade of Courage grants a 5%, 10%, or 15% damage buff for 8, 12, or 16 seconds.' Desperate Salvation 'complements Serenade of Salvation Identity Skill' → longer healing duration.

commitment.evidence: Support skills in LA are typically instant-cast to enable reactive healing/shielding. Serenade activation is instant.

mechanics_notes: 1) Desperate Salvation Bard is one of two MANDATORY group-support slots in LA endgame raids (alongside Blessed Aura Paladin). Zero solo-context relevance. GROUP-CONTEXT annotation — C2 ruling prediction: system-record/negative for solo. 2) The THREE-BAR SERENADE system is the richest support resource economy in LA — three distinct charge levels with scaling potency creates genuine resource management decisions (do I use Salvation at 2 bars now or wait for 3?). This is the most nuanced support economy in the corpus. 3) Bard is unique in having TWO identity skills from the SAME meter (Salvation vs Courage) — the meta question is whether to heal or buff with accumulated bars. Desperate Salvation tips the balance strongly toward healing; True Courage tilts toward buffing. 4) Stigma (debuff skill) is Bard's enemy-weakening tool — applies a debuff that marks enemies for amplified damage. This creates a small offensive-utility rider on a pure-support identity. 5) SUPPORT ECONOMY NOTE: The Serenade of Courage (even in Desperate Salvation builds) represents one of LA's cleanest '+% party damage' mechanics — 15% at 3 bars for 16 seconds is a massive raid-wide amplification when timed correctly.
stabilization_patch: Desperate Salvation has been the dominant Bard identity from day one. True Courage is situational and has never displaced it in raid meta.
tier_standing_current: S-tier (support slot). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Tier reflects group-content demand; solo tier is inapplicable. Healing/shield values scale with Specialization stat (gear-indexed).

folk_name: True Courage Bard (Damage Support / DPS Hybrid)
honing_confound: True Courage Bard is primarily a group-content identity even if it deals more personal damage than Desperate Salvation. Crit rate bonus and personal damage scale with Specialization stat.

delivery.evidence: Same aura-pulse delivery as Desperate Salvation for party buffs. Serenade of Courage is the primary identity use. Personal damage skills are the same as Desperate Salvation.

footprint.evidence: Serenade of Courage is a party-wide buff (covers party within aura range). Same zone pattern as Desperate Salvation's Serenade placement.

geo_text: Same spatial identity as Desperate Salvation — safe-range support positioning. True Courage shifts the Serenade spend bias from Salvation (healing) to Courage (damage buff). Crit Rate bonus makes personal damage skills contribute more than in Desperate Salvation builds.

defense.evidence: True Courage reduces healing emphasis (Serenade of Salvation used less). Defense is through shields from other skills. Healing output is lower than Desperate Salvation.

economy.builder_source: Same as Desperate Salvation. True Courage identity tips spend decision toward Serenade of Courage (damage buff) over Serenade of Salvation (healing).
economy.plain_text: Same three-bar system as Desperate Salvation. TRUE COURAGE IDENTITY: engraving significantly amplifies Serenade of Courage effectiveness and adds Crit Rate bonus to party members affected. Meta decision shifts: spend bars on Courage (damage buff) rather than Salvation (healing). Party receives damage amplification + crit rate rather than sustained healing. Less healing output = more raid damage enabled (in theory) but requires healer/shield coverage from another source.

tempo.evidence: True Courage is still a sustained support identity — Serenade of Courage provides a 16-second window (at 3 bars) that must be refreshed. Less 'burst' than a burst DPS but has distinct windows.

amp.value: Serenade of Courage: party +5/10/15% damage + Crit Rate bonus (True Courage amplified). True Courage engraving amplifies Serenade of Courage potency above base.
amp.evidence: Search results: 'True Courage tries to turn the Bard into a lighter DPS by juicing Serenade of Courage and granting Crit Rate.' Serenade of Courage base: +5/10/15% for 8/12/16s.

mechanics_notes: 1) True Courage is the 'less meta, more fun' Bard identity — it enables the player to contribute personal DPS between buff windows while maintaining party amplification via Serenade of Courage. But parties prefer Desperate Salvation for its healing reliability. 2) The C2 RULING RELEVANCE here: True Courage is a GROUP-CONTEXT support identity even though it deals more personal damage. The solo-DPS output is still inadequate for solo content. Both Bard identities = group-context/negative-for-solo per C2 ruling prediction. 3) PARTY DAMAGE AMPLIFICATION: Serenade of Courage at 3 bars (+15% party damage for 16s) is one of the highest time-limited damage amplifications available in LA. True Courage amplifies this further. This is the genre's cleanest example of 'identity-as-party-buff rather than identity-as-personal-damage.' 4) The True Courage vs Desperate Salvation choice IS a genuine meta tradeoff — True Courage enables higher party damage output at cost of healing reliability, Desperate Salvation provides healing reliability at cost of party damage opportunity. The tradeoff is raid-composition dependent.
stabilization_patch: True Courage was briefly meta in specific raid compositions (2023) where another healer covered the reduced Salvation output. Desperate Salvation has been dominant otherwise.
tier_standing_current: B-tier support (niche vs Desperate Salvation in standard raid comps). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: same support stat scaling.
